notes.title: The Full Release is here! + Exclusive Release Skin! - Patch Notes v1.1.0.0
notes.content:
🔥 The Full Release is here! 🔥 



🐸 To celebrate, everyone who logs in until October 17th (and don't have the EA Skin) will receive an exclusive Release skin! Don't miss out! 



💚 Special thanks to everyone who supported us during Early Access, and also to those who are supporting us in the Full Release!




🔥 New Features:

New creatures: Crabs and Snails!

Exclusive Release skin!

✨ Improvements:

Visual improvements in the UI and UX.

Improvements to the credit system, rebalancing the game economy.

Corrections to the SFX, Ambience and Music volumes.


🦀 Check our Teaser to see all the new features implemented:
[previewyoutube="GPAQ9SOi6C4;full"][/previewyoutube]
🍄 And if you have any feedback, curiosity, suggestion, or found any bug, please share it with us on our Discord Forum!  

🐸 Stay froggy! ✨

notes.title: Full Release date + Early Access Skin - Patch Notes v1.0.9.0
notes.content:
🔥 We're happy to announce that our Full Release date has been confirmed: September 16th!

🐸 To celebrate, everyone who logs in until September 15th will receive an exclusive Early Access skin! Don't miss out! 

🦀 In our new teaser you can also get a sneak peek at the new features coming with the Full Release: the Crabs and Snails!

[previewyoutube="GPAQ9SOi6C4;full"][/previewyoutube]

🍄If you have any feedback, curiosity, suggestion, or found any bug, please share it with us on our Discord Forum! Stay froggy!

notes.title: Turkish Localization arrived! - Patch Notes v1.0.4.0
notes.content:
🔥 New Features:

 Game Localization to Turkish!
     Thanks to the kind help of Ali İbrahim Çırpan and İbrahim Büber, the game now has a Turkish language option!


🎮 Gameplay:

 Implemented "Coyote Time" in the game. Now you have more control when jumping off edges!


🛠️ Fixes:

 Fixed the Bug where upon completing the game the money earned in the match was not saved.
 Navigation using controllers in the Options Menu has been fixed.
 Increased the size of the collision HitBox for NPCs.


And stay tuned, more localizations are coming in future updates!

If you have any feedback, suggestions, or found any bugs, please share them in our Discord Forum!

Keep hopping! 🐸🍄

notes.title: HOTFIX + PATCH NOTES v1.0.3.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889260/3d0a8958af7975456d815d9514a5bcc342065591.png

HOTFIX + PATCH NOTES

🛠️ Fixes:

 The final Story Mode map is now loaded when completing Very Hard difficulty.
 The Achievement for completing Very Hard difficulty is now unlockable on Steam.
 Ranked Mode is now unlocked by completing Very Hard difficulty in Story Mode (Let's Jump!).
 The time for the mosquito to disappear after attacking is now corrected.


🎮 Balancing:

 NPCs now appear earlier in the levels.
 Easy difficulty now has fewer maps.


☀️ Quality of life:

 Improvements in the interaction with the family when completing Story Mode (Let's Jump!).
 The Progress Bar that indicates the next difficulty has been increased on the HUD for better readability.
 The hitbox for collecting Upgrades has been increased.
 Mosquitoes now have VFX when they disappear.

notes.title: Swamp Up | Early access now available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889260/fcd6a6799bca119a6d2bf05532c84df30aa02b7e.png

Explore the swamp, face exciting challenges and immerse yourself in our unique world. 

We are very happy to present to you the first version of Swamp Up in early access!
It was a rich path of learning and discoveries, but of course, our journey does not end here.

In the coming months we will be adjusting everything necessary, adding new features, balancing, always valuing your feedback. We would love to hear your feedback during this time.
Oh! You can submit bugs or suggestions right here in the Discussions area or on our Forum on Discord, so you help us improve the game even more!

We hope you have fun playing Swamp Up!
Start your adventure today and be part of our journey!

Thank you for supporting us.
See you in the swamp!

[previewyoutube=TtHewLmpr08;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Early Access launches | June 18th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889260/97e58f1f705fd9a3c582ca05bfcff27dd522ced1.png


We're excited to announce that our game, Swamp Up, will be launching in Early Access on June 18th! 🐸🍄

This is your chance to be among the first to explore our unique game world and give us valuable feedback as we continue to develop and improve the game. 
Don't miss out on this adventure. Add Swamp Up to your wishlist on Steam now and be ready to jump into the action. 

Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to share this journey with you!
